review_scope: R01: CodeLlama basic few-shot complete input budget
R02: Gemma2 hierarchical zero-shot template and generation handling
review_method: read original vs revised unified diffs
read revised target blocks with line numbers

checks.detail: Template is rendered first; complete text is tokenized with truncation=False; total input_ids length is checked before model call; no silent deletion of query or any appended code context.
Uses finite model.config.max_position_embeddings, reserves MAX_NEW_TOKENS plus64 tokens, rejects absent/unreasonable capacity. Budget is for the whole final input, not only the example header.
Generation kwargs unchanged: MAX_NEW_TOKENS, do_sample=True, temperature=0.2, top_p=0.95, pad_token_id. Label definitions, 10-example header and parser unchanged.
Actually encodes rendered text and sets add_special_tokens=False, preventing a second special-token insertion; truncation=False retains full input.
max_len is validated and used. With a finite valid context_limit, budget=min(max_len,context_limit-MAX_NEW_TOKENS); excessive complete input fails explicitly.

Passes template input_ids and attention_mask; preserves max_new_tokens and inherited generation settings. Decodes outputs[0][input_tokens:] only, skips special tokens, and returns first line instead of splitting decoded prompt text.
Replaced R01 tokenization and R02 encoding/generate/decode statements remain commented in their original local positions.
Both revised files parsed via ast.parse. This is syntax validation only; no source imports or runtime functions were executed.

known_out_of_scope_or_unverified.detail: Existing default special-token encoding remains, so the separately audited CodeLlama duplicate-BOS issue is not fixed by R01. It does not defeat the new complete-length budget, which counts actual encoded input. Do not describe this batch as fixing all prompt-format issues.

If context_limit is absent or invalid, only max_len is enforced. Expected Gemma2 model configuration supplies max_position_embeddings; runtime configuration was not loaded or checked in this static-only review.

No conclusion about output quality, runtime memory, actual tokenizer behavior, or historical manuscript numbers follows from this review. No new code-context experiment or shot-count change was added.
